i have measured the diameters of 4 bacterial colonies, which measure as follows 2.2 1.6 3.3 4.0 mm. this calculates the total diameter

```{r}
total_colony_diameter <-sum(2.2,1.6,3.3,4)

```

the total diameter of my colonies is 11.1mm
